notes: Pure free roam in a car around a city, with no jobs, races or chases, has no lap and no finish, so it is Simulation on Vehicle Sim; world-open is both the preset's shape and the literal ask for an open world. The answer sizes that open world at a few city blocks, so it is one contiguous surface built in a single pass rather than several zones, which keeps it off P4. path-road-vehicle carries the drivable street network, settlement-density the present-day urban blocks, and npc-population the AI people and traffic that were explicitly requested, which is the ambient-population row rather than any kind of spawner; resource-shared was dropped as nothing is extracted. Decided without a user: free roam means no objective or exit is placed anywhere, and with no interiors asked for the buildings stay street-side facades, so the build stays on P0.
